title: Lowest paid in each department
statementMd:
List the lowest-paid employee of each department (first name, department id, salary).

Expected columns: `first_name`, `department_id`, `salary`.

Tables: `employees`, `departments`.

Row order does not matter.
hints: Compare to `MIN(salary)` of the same department.
solutionMd:
```sql
SELECT e.first_name, e.department_id, e.salary FROM employees e WHERE e.department_id IS NOT NULL AND e.salary = (SELECT MIN(e2.salary) FROM employees e2 WHERE e2.department_id = e.department_id);
```

Compare with your own query; the result sets must match.
